name: MATHUSLA
full_name: MAssive Timing Hodoscope for Ultra-Stable neutraL pArticles
summary: MATHUSLA is proposed at a surface site near CERN LHC CMS Point 5. It targets long-lived particles at the High-Luminosity LHC; design sensitivities are not measured limits.
detection_principle: Neutral long-lived particles produced at the LHC pass through overburden into a surface decay volume. Multilayer timed tracking reconstructs upward displaced vertices to reject downward cosmic rays.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
